Settings.Title: movies + tv quality
Settings.Help: Maximum bitrate for movies and TV shows. Streams above this are transcoded by the server to fit. Automatic fits the measured connection to the server (settings › general › optimize for this TV); maximum allows up to 120 Mbps.

Settings.Title: movies + tv resolution
Settings.Help: Maximum output resolution for movies and TV shows. Higher-resolution files are downscaled by the server's transcoder. Automatic plays files at full size when this TV decodes them, and has the server convert to the screen's size only when it must convert anyway.

Settings.Title: direct play
Settings.Help: Play files in their original container and codecs when this device supports them. Off forces server-side transcoding to HLS.

Settings.Title: audio output
Settings.Help: Surround sends Dolby and DTS on to a receiver or soundbar as they are. Stereo decodes them on this TV and mixes them down to two channels. Soundtracks play as they are either way; this also sets what the server converts audio to, when it must. Automatic picks surround when a receiver, soundbar or multichannel HDMI output is connected.

Settings.Title: match frame rate
Settings.Help: Switches the TV to the film's own frame rate (23.976, 24, 25, 50 Hz…) while it plays, so camera pans don't judder, and back afterwards. The screen may go dark for a moment as the TV switches. Only where the TV offers that rate at the same resolution.

Settings.Title: play next episode
Settings.Help: Continue to the next episode when the current one ends.

Settings.Title: next episode countdown
Settings.Help: Delay before the next episode starts, shown on the Up Next card. OK plays immediately; Back cancels.

Settings.Title: trickplay previews
Settings.Help: Thumbnail previews while scrubbing. Requires trickplay images on the server (Dashboard › Libraries › Trickplay).

Settings.Title: sleep timer
Settings.Help: Stops playback after this long without remote input. “After this item” stops when the current title ends.

Settings.Title: OK pauses and plays
Settings.Help: With the controls hidden, OK pauses and plays straight away. Hold OK, or press Up, for the controls.

Settings.Title: left and right skip
Settings.Help: With the controls hidden, Left replays and Right skips by the distances below, without opening the controls. Hold either to scan faster; the picture jumps when you let go.

Settings.Title: replay jumps back
Settings.Help: Seek distance for Left and the Replay button.

Settings.Title: skip jumps ahead
Settings.Help: Seek distance for Right and the Skip button.

Settings.Title: controls when a video starts
Settings.Help: Show the controls for a few seconds as a video starts. Off, it starts clean, and OK, Left and Right work from the first second.

Settings.Title: up shows the info bar
Settings.Help: With the controls hidden, up shows a slim bar with the time, when it ends, and the picture and sound format. Up again brings the full controls.

Settings.Title: info when paused
Settings.Help: When you pause with OK, show the title, how far in you are, the time and when it'll end, as Media Center did.

Settings.Title: down for subtitles
Settings.Help: With the controls hidden, Down opens the subtitle choices directly, instead of the controls.

Settings.Title: subtitles on replay
Settings.Help: When subtitles are off and you replay with Left, show them for the replayed seconds, for when you missed a line; they go off again after.

Settings.Title: skip intros
Settings.Help: Action at intro segments. Requires media segments (Jellyfin 10.10+, e.g. the Intro Skipper plugin). Individual shows and movies can override this.

Settings.Title: skip credits
Settings.Help: Action at end-credit segments. With Play next episode on, skipping credits opens Up Next.

Settings.Title: skip commercials
Settings.Help: Action at commercial segments marked in recordings (e.g. by Comskip).

Settings.Title: skip recaps + previews
Settings.Help: Action at recap (“previously on”) and preview segments.

Settings.Title: audio language
Settings.Help: Preferred soundtrack language. Automatic uses the file's default audio track.

Settings.Title: subtitles
Settings.Help: Automatic: default and forced tracks only. Always: any track in the subtitle language. Forced only: foreign-dialogue tracks. Off: none.

Settings.Title: subtitle language
Settings.Help: Preferred subtitle track language.

Settings.Title: subtitle size
Settings.Help: Text subtitle scale relative to the standard size. Image subtitles (PGS, VobSub) keep their authored size.

Settings.Title: subtitle background
Settings.Help: Draw text subtitles on a translucent black band for legibility over bright scenes.

Settings.Title: styled subtitles
Settings.Help: Shows ASS/SSA subtitles (common with anime) with their own fonts, colours and positions. Off shows them as plain text.

Settings.Title: remember choices per show
Settings.Help: When you pick a soundtrack or subtitles during an episode, the rest of the show's episodes start with the same.

Settings.Title: night mode
Settings.Help: Evens out loud and quiet: explosions come down, dialogue comes up. Needs Android 9 or later, and doesn't apply to sound passed through to a receiver. Also in the player's playback panel.

Settings.Title: video decoding
Settings.Help: Automatic uses the TV's hardware decoders, with its software decoders filling in for formats the hardware can't play (at sizes the processor keeps up with). Hardware only leaves those to the server. Prefer software tries software decoders first, which can get round a faulty hardware decoder. The app's own (FFmpeg) decodes in the app itself, for formats and boxes nothing else handles (AV1 on older boxes, MPEG-2); it's the slowest.

Settings.Title: HEVC (H.265)
Settings.Help: Play HEVC as-is when this TV decodes it. Turn off if HEVC stutters or shows a black screen; the server then converts it to H.264.

Settings.Title: VP9
Settings.Help: Play VP9 as-is when this TV decodes it. Off makes the server convert it.

Settings.Title: AV1
Settings.Help: Play AV1 as-is when this TV decodes it. Off makes the server convert it.

Settings.Title: HDR (HDR10, HLG)
Settings.Help: Play HDR as HDR when the TV and screen support it. Off, or on a screen without HDR, the server converts it to SDR with tone mapping.

Settings.Title: Dolby Vision
Settings.Help: Play Dolby Vision when the TV and screen support it. Otherwise its HDR10 base is played where there is one, or the server converts it.

Settings.Title: decode audio in the app
Settings.Help: Play DTS, DTS-HD, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Digital and more with the app's own decoder when the TV can't, instead of having the server convert them.

Settings.Title: audio passthrough
Settings.Help: Send Dolby and DTS audio untouched to a receiver or soundbar that supports it. Off decodes it on this TV instead.

Settings.Title: high-resolution audio
Settings.Help: Keeps 24-bit and high sample-rate audio (FLAC, ALAC, WAV, TrueHD) at full resolution all the way to the TV or receiver. Off plays it as 16-bit. With stereo output, sound is mixed down to 16-bit stereo either way.

Settings.Title: lossless conversions
Settings.Help: When the server has to convert audio (music the TV can't play, like APE, WavPack or DSD), convert it to FLAC so no quality is lost, as long as the quality setting allows (8 Mbps or more). Off, or on slower connections, it's compressed instead.

Settings.Title: live tv quality
Settings.Help: Maximum bitrate for live TV streams. Live streams can't buffer far ahead, so automatic leaves more headroom than for movies.

Settings.Title: live tv resolution
Settings.Help: Maximum output resolution for live TV. Higher-resolution channels are downscaled by the server. Automatic works as for movies.

Settings.Title: channel banner
Settings.Help: Show channel number, name and current program for 3.5 seconds after tuning.

Settings.Title: mini guide
Settings.Help: While watching live TV, OK brings up Media Center's mini guide: what's on now and next on each channel, without leaving the picture.

Settings.Title: start recording
Settings.Help: When new recordings start. Starting a few minutes early catches shows that begin before their listed time.

Settings.Title: stop recording
Settings.Help: When new recordings stop. Stopping late catches shows (especially sports) that run over.

Settings.Title: series: new episodes only
Settings.Help: When you record a series, record only episodes that haven't aired before, skipping reruns.

Settings.Title: show pictures in random order
Settings.Help: Shuffle the pictures in a slide show instead of showing them by name.

Settings.Title: show pictures in subfolders
Settings.Help: Include pictures in folders inside the one you start the slide show from.

Settings.Title: show caption
Settings.Help: Show each picture's name and position while a slide show plays.

Settings.Title: show song information
Settings.Help: When music is playing during a slide show: show the song title and artist at the start and end of each song, the whole time, or never.

Choices.Label: at beginning and end of song

Settings.Title: transition type
Settings.Help: How one picture changes to the next: a slow pan and zoom with a cross-fade (animated), a plain cross-fade, or an instant cut.

Settings.Title: show each picture for
Settings.Help: How long each picture stays on screen in a slide show.

Settings.Title: font size
Settings.Help: Scales all text, independent of interface size. Layouts reflow; at the largest sizes long titles may be shortened with an ellipsis.

Settings.Title: interface size
Settings.Help: Scales all menus and text. 100% is designed for a Full HD TV at couch distance.

Settings.Title: player controls size
Settings.Help: Scale of the playback overlay: title, progress bar and transport controls.

Settings.Title: interface sounds
Settings.Help: Navigation, selection and startup sounds.

Settings.Title: video behind menus
Settings.Help: Keep video playing full-screen, dimmed, behind the menus when you leave the player.

Settings.Title: startup animation
Settings.Help: Play the startup animation and sound at launch.

Settings.Title: startup animation style
Settings.Help: The look of the startup animation: ribbons of light, a swirl of lights fusing into the orb, glass shards assembling, an aurora, or Media Center's own zoom out of the blue.

Settings.Title: animated background
Settings.Help: Ribbons of light sweep in from the left and drift behind the start menu, carrying on from the startup animation.

Settings.Title: clock
Settings.Help: Show the time at the top centre of every screen.

Settings.Title: screensaver
Settings.Help: After a while with no buttons pressed, your server's artwork fills the screen, one picture after another. Music keeps playing, and a paused video stays just where it was; not while a video plays. Any button brings you back. While it's on, the app keeps the TV's own screensaver away (that one would stop the music). Media Center can also be the TV's own screensaver, where the TV allows it.

Settings.Title: screensaver shows
Settings.Help: What the screensaver shows: your films' and shows' backdrops (with their logos), your pictures, or both.

Settings.Title: screensaver picture time
Settings.Help: How long each picture stays on the screensaver.

Settings.Title: music visualizer
Settings.Help: Light that moves with the music behind now playing, as Media Center's visualizations did.

Settings.Title: lyrics
Settings.Help: Shows a song's lyrics on now playing when the server has them, following along where they're timed.

Settings.Title: demo library
Settings.Help: Offer “try the demo” on the sign-in screen. Turns off automatically after the first sign-in to a server.

Settings.Title: check for updates
Settings.Help: Looks for a new version of Media Center on GitHub now and then, and offers to install it on the start menu. You can also check any time in settings › about.

Settings.Title: switch server in tasks
Settings.Help: Adds a switch server button to Tasks on the start menu, next to switch users.
